sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 89 September 28–29 channel briefs screened.
Signed-in X organizer feed and focused conference/team search reviewed; 283 public account candidates sampled, including teams, partners, commentators and quoted accounts.
176 repository paths scanned and 9 selected changes inspected at patch level. SN66 competition page and SN64 model card read directly.
Signed-in AlphaGap leaderboard, SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and 115 dated Moments reviewed.
Previous seven editions compared for missed announcements, unresolved incidents and upcoming events. Full-roster market outliers and emission leaders checked.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked; new public Gamma video added. October 1 SN49 Nepher stream remains upcoming; latest members upload remains September 25.
accessGaps: Research ran from 12:53 PM ET to 1:01 PM ET. Later conference sessions, including the scheduled Gamma discussion and Pitchtensor, are outside this edition.
13 repository paths returned access errors; 9 public account candidates returned no usable post links. Account sampling is not exhaustive X coverage; no Grok scan is claimed.
Channel briefs are AI-generated secondary reports. Team-attributed reports, community reports and primary releases are distinguished; code alone does not establish production deployment.

SN78 UMI’s linked Cohort 4 endpoint returned 404. SN87 Provenonce’s initial event-page response contained placeholders; its testnet milestone remains a project claim rather than an independently reconciled chain event.

SN117 feed cards and event-detail amounts disagree; detail-page figures are attributed explicitly. SN82 identity remains unverified after re-registration, so historical returns must not be assigned to the former project.
Conference figures and benchmark measurements are attributed to their presenters. No purchases, miner payout tests or independent model benchmarks were performed.

decisions.reason: The former SN82 Compelle deregistration and subsequent registration were already covered. Current identity remains unverified, and the 117.35% seven-day return spans that transition; it is not evidence of a fresh Compelle catalyst.

editorialDecisions: SN64 leads on the trained 8B phone demonstration and public checkpoints. The 40.75B run used random weights and must never be presented as a trained working model.
Gamma is a 2027 proposal; proposed dollar-denominated credits are not cash redemption or a live stablecoin. No X posting or recurring automation is authorized for this daily run.
SN46 primary live-mining post supersedes the conditional channel brief. Target-based burn code does not establish universal zero burn or a completed payout.
SN66 primary leaderboard confirms current submissions and rules, upgrading the secondary DEFLATE lead.
SN68 lab synthesis is research progress, not drug approval. Prior unsupported approval wording is not repeated.
SN51 investment is disclosed by the fund partner; amount and structure are not published. Lium and Stillcore feeds were cross-checked.
SN111 September 27 launch is late-confirmed organizer reporting; SN124 Sentinel is a preview. SN38 model-size upgrade remains planned.
SN93 TAPE name is now in organizer recap, but yesterday already covered its two-application launch; no duplicate standalone story. SN9 SDK and SN85 event streaming likewise already covered.
SN102 coming-out-of-stealth post provides no concrete newly available product details; do not turn attendance or teaser into a launch.
SN14 collaboration with SN120 is acknowledged by one side but the current post has no new measured outcome; no separate partnership launch asserted.
SN120 September 30 14:00 UTC evaluation change remains upcoming from September 26; no completed activation asserted. Recent admission correction already covered yesterday.

SN17 voting is scheduled September 29–October 1; no verified game-jam winner found. SN23 validator recovery, SN55 scoring investigation and SN94 mining restart remain unresolved without a fresh supported resolution.
SN78 cohort results do not confirm reward restart; results endpoint failure documented. SN118 screening closure and reward status kept separate.
SN105 Beam Gamma name is not evidence of protocol Gamma rollout. No unverified miner attack allegations published.
SN117 detailed event pages supply block 9169496 and larger lock amounts than cards. Ranking change is not verified ownership transfer, and unlock is not a sale.
Other Moments contain routine wallet-flow labels or unsupported intent language; exclude inferred motives. One card incorrectly labels SN39 Cathedral, so it is not used as identity evidence.
Market snapshot has only SN82 above required absolute thresholds; SN38, SN49 and SN95 also reviewed as recent or near-threshold movers. Price never decides five-star status.
Emission leaders SN51/SN64/SN120/SN107/SN4/SN44/SN53/SN3/SN8/SN80/SN15 reviewed. SN107 conference update is still upcoming; routine code and unchanged promotions omitted.
Unrelated StonkFun pairs, broad platform stats, sports posts and generic AI news excluded. TAO Base-pair recap is not a fresh launch.
New public YouTube video VQAAbraL8Xk verified with title, September 29 publication and 2459-second duration. Removed/postponed videos remain excluded.
